title: Author-facing finding
description: The only shape a finding takes when it reaches the PR author. Built from a vetted.json row that verdict.py admissibility() keeps. Enum values are the tokens in scripts/verdicts.py.

impact.description: What goes wrong for a user or caller, in one or two sentences.

actor_roles.description: Roles that trigger the failure, from a role-matrix run. Empty means the role matrix did not run; the finding then says so in not_checked.

entry_point.description: Entry point the reproduction goes through, e.g. "api4 DELETE /api/v4/x".

repro_cmd.description: One command that reproduces the failure on head and passes on base.

base_result.description: Mechanical verdict on the merge-base: NEW_PR_BUG or NEW_API for a test, DIFF for a Mode D input.

contradicts.description: The PR text line (description or commit message) the behaviour contradicts, or null when the bug is not against a stated claim.

checked.description: What was verified (for example: fix-commit check passed, caller reached).

not_checked.description: What was not verified and why. Shown to the author next to the finding.

root_cause.description: Group key: the root-cause file_line. Kept tests that name the exact same file_line are one root cause; findings.json carries one item per group.

related.description: Other kept tests with the same root cause. Each is a separate reproduction of the same bug.
